snippet.title: Nullpoint Protocol - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
👁️ Out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3520420/Nullpoint_Protocol/
👁️ Join the Discord:  https://www.discord.gg/XJC8SWpE74

___ 

Nullpoint Protocol is a roguelite boss-rush for 1-4 players where every fight feels like a high-level MMO raid. 

Each boss unleashes complex attack patterns, which you must learn to read and dodge. Every run gives you another opportunity to hone your skills as you prepare to face the final boss. You’re on a fixed timeline though, you’ll need to make some bold choices throughout your run to make sure you are ready on time to face the final boss. 

To do so, you’ll be rewarded with a selection of random skill upgrades: from meteor strikes to turrets, to heals - inventing creative and unique skillsets will be critical to your mission's success.

Whether you are braving the void on your own or choose to face the darkness alongside trusty allies, the difficulty will scale appropriately so that every run feels challenging, but fair and worth "just one more try." Nullpoint Protocol is a particularly great couch co-op experience, getting together with a few friends and making your way through the gauntlet of bosses is bound to be a blast.

#indiegame #gamedev #roguelike
